prose: A New York Times report, linked by Daring Fireball, describes disagreement inside the US administration over Nvidia chip controls, with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick favoring a softer approach than some colleagues. It reports accusations that the department has been too close to Nvidia. These are attributed accounts of policy conflict, not a legal determination of wrongdoing.
highlights: Nvidia sales to Asia are central
Criticism is attributed to officials and lawmakers
Accusations do not establish legal findings
